reason: I cut most of the hair myself in one or two chairs, so chair tracking, cash-drawer checks and stylist selfies solve problems I don't really have. The WhatsApp reminders and wallet look nice and modern, but not ₹999 every month on what I earn.
objection: Making my one helper check in with a selfie will feel like I don't trust him, and paying ₹4,999 plus ₹999 a month is a lot for a shop this small when WhatsApp and Instagram already do most of it for free.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper solo-owner plan with no setup fee, around ₹299-399 a month, focused on WhatsApp reminders, bills and the referral reward, without the staff-monitoring part.
